limits: Local CPU microbenchmarks, not a gdev frame speedup.
Prepared spring and bounds results assume caller-retained columns; record conversion each call can erase gains.
Field timing scans all-declared-dirty but unchanged tiles, favorable for SIMD; early-change semantics covered by differential tests.
Paired SIMD timings include fixture setup, allocations, execution and complete decoding; comparisons outside timing.
Spring and bounds run 16 passes; paired guest memory is a shared high-water mark, not per-variant allocation or process RSS.
Worker timings include batch dispatch and output copying, exclude initial warm pool/context setup; one-worker baseline also retains context.
Four workers use more guest memory, native heaps and thread stacks; reported memory is committed guest linear memory only.
No automatic game/ECS parallelism; host owns and supplies the pool.
No per-job timeout; service code must finish jobs and honor stop.
Catalog hashes of witnesses are SHA256 over compact JSON arrays; raw witnesses are reproducible from workload fixtures.
